priorityList: Maintain Blade Flurry, aiming to use it at low Combo Points.
Use Keep It Rolling (if talented) when you have 4+ buffs; if missing Broadside, wait until the last second of the lowest duration buff.
Use Adrenaline Rush on cooldown at low Combo Points.
Use Blade Rush on cooldown as a builder.
Cast Between the Eyes on cooldown with 6+ Combo Points.
Use Killing Spree on cooldown at 6+ Combo Points.
Cast Dispatch as your main finisher with 6+ Combo Points if it is buffed by Coup de Grace.
Cast Dispatch as your main finisher at 6+ Combo Points.
Cast Pistol Shot if you have 6 stacks of Opportunity, or at 1-3 Combo Points if you have 3 stacks.
Cast Sinister Strike to generate Combo Points.
Keep Blade Flurry active at all times to enable multi-target cleave.
Use Adrenaline Rush on cooldown to maximize Energy regeneration and reduce global cooldowns.
Maintain Roll the Bones buffs, re-rolling if you have no buffs or only one low-value buff (e.g., Buried Treasure) unless using Keep It Rolling.
Use Vanish on cooldown to enter Stealth and trigger the Crackshot window.
Cast Between the Eyes at max Combo Points, prioritizing its use during the Crackshot/Stealth window for massive cleave damage.
Cast Coupe de Grace at max Combo Points to consume Finesse stacks and deal significant finishing damage.
Use Keep It Rolling when you have a strong set of Roll the Bones buffs (2+) to extend their duration.
Cast Dispatch at max Combo Points as a filler finisher if Coupe de Grace is not available and Between the Eyes is on cooldown.
Use Blade Rush on cooldown for high AoE burst and Energy restoration.
Cast Pistol Shot when Opportunity procs to generate Combo Points efficiently.
Use Sinister Strike as your primary filler generator to build Combo Points.
